# Awesome AI Tools ### A field-tested AI stack for building, automating, and monetizing ideas.

Content & Video • Monetization • Development • Automation • Markets • Voice

> [!NOTE] > This is not an exhaustive directory. Every tool here earned its place through real use in projects, workflows, or businesses. > [!IMPORTANT] > Some links are referral or affiliate links. They may support this project at no extra cost to you, but placement is based on usefulness—not commission. ## ✨ Find your tool | I want to… | Start with | |---|---| | Create and schedule social content | [ViralWave Studio](https://viralwavestudio.com) or [Postiz](https://postiz.com/?ref=chris34) | | Generate polished AI videos | [HeyGen](https://heygen.com/?sid=rewardful&via=chris-porter) | | Monetize a custom GPT | [Authflow](https://authflow.ai) | | Research and sell products online | [EverBee](https://www.everbee.io/?via=christopher-porter) or [Printify](https://try.printify.com/mhf23rn5orq2) | | Build an app or website with AI | [Lovable](https://lovablelabs.pxf.io/3kzOJd) or [10Web](https://10web.io/?_from=chris35) | | Automate a workflow | [Make.com](https://www.make.com/en/register?pc=viralwave) | | Extract structured public web data | [CoreClaw](https://coreclaw.com?fpr=chris69&fp_sid=aitools) or [Apify](https://www.apify.com?fpr=p2hrc6) | | Monitor websites and feeds | [RSS.app](https://rss.app?fpr=chris90) | | Follow a structured morning market workflow | [KamdenAI](https://kamdenai.com/) | | Generate realistic AI voice | [ElevenLabs](https://try.elevenlabs.io/n64zmcqt1hc7) | | Deploy an AI customer-support agent | [Chatbase](https://link.chatbase.co/chris-porter) | | Automate business communication | [CallHippo](https://callhippo.com?fp_ref=christopher56) | ## 📱 Content & Video

ViralWave Studio

AI reels · Scheduling · Social publishing

Transforms prompts into social videos and schedules them across your accounts, taking a workflow from idea to publication in one place.

Why it stands out: It removes the repetitive work behind maintaining a consistent social presence.

Explore ViralWave Studio →

Postiz

Social management · Design · Cross-posting

An open-source social media suite with an AI content assistant, built-in design tools, analytics, team features, and broad platform support.

Why it stands out: It combines creation, publishing, automation, and analytics—and can be self-hosted.

Explore Postiz →

HeyGen

AI video · Avatars · Translation

Creates complete videos from text, images, or audio, with voiceovers, multilingual translation, avatars, and brand-aware styles.

Why it stands out: It makes polished, multilingual video production fast and approachable.

Explore HeyGen →

Best fit

Choose by workflow

ViralWave Studio for prompt-to-post reel automation.

Postiz for broad social management and self-hosting.

HeyGen for presenter-led, translated, or branded AI video.

Back to top ↑

## 💰 Monetization & E-commerce

Authflow

GPT paywalls · Access control · Subscriptions

Adds secure paywalls to custom GPTs so creators can package premium AI experiences for paying users.

Why it stands out: It provides a direct path from useful GPT to paid product.

Explore Authflow →

Printify

Print on demand · Fulfillment · Global delivery

Lets creators sell custom products without holding inventory while the platform handles production, fulfillment, and shipping.

Why it stands out: It turns designs into a scalable product business with minimal operational overhead.

Explore Printify →

EverBee

Product research · Etsy SEO · Market validation

Surfaces product, keyword, and marketplace data to help creators validate ideas, spot demand, and improve listings.

Why it stands out: It replaces guesswork with useful signals before you invest in a product.

Explore EverBee →

A practical path

Research → Create → Monetize

Use EverBee to validate demand, Printify to fulfill physical products, and Authflow to monetize AI-native services.

Back to top ↑

## 🚀 Development & Websites

Lovable

AI app builder · Prototyping · Conversational development

Turns plain-language product ideas into working apps and websites through a chat-based building experience.

Why it stands out: It dramatically shortens the distance between an idea and a usable prototype.

Explore Lovable →

10Web

AI websites · Hosting · Optimization

Combines AI-assisted website creation with managed hosting and performance tooling for a streamlined web workflow.

Why it stands out: It bundles building, hosting, and optimization into one approachable platform.

Explore 10Web →

Back to top ↑

## 🔧 Automation & Data

Make.com

Visual automation · App integrations · Workflows

Connects apps and services in a visual workflow builder so repetitive business processes can run automatically.

Why it stands out: It makes sophisticated multi-step automation accessible without traditional coding.

Explore Make.com →

Apify

Web scraping · Data extraction · APIs

Provides ready-made scrapers and serverless Actors for collecting structured, real-time data from the web.

Why it stands out: Its marketplace of existing scrapers can save substantial development time.

Explore Apify →

RSS.app

RSS generation · Monitoring · Content aggregation

Creates feeds from websites and social sources for streamlined monitoring, curation, and distribution.

Why it stands out: It turns scattered content sources into automation-friendly feeds.

Explore RSS.app →

CoreClaw

Data Workers · Web extraction · Structured exports

Offers ready-to-run Workers for extracting public website data, scheduling collection jobs, monitoring sources, and exporting structured results.

Why it stands out: Its Worker marketplace supports no-code runs, while its API, callbacks, and custom Worker tooling give developers room to build deeper automations.

Explore CoreClaw →

Back to top ↑

## 📈 Trading & Market Intelligence

KamdenAI

Stock signals · Risk sizing · Results tracking

Organizes market-day research into a focused morning sequence: a 9:15 watchlist, 9:28 locked field, 9:30 confirmed signals, and official 10:05 results.

Why it stands out: It combines entry, stop, target, risk, reward, and position-sizing examples with a results ledger, journal, community, and developer webhooks.

Explore KamdenAI →

Know the scope

Research · Signals · User-controlled execution

KamdenAI is a stock signal and educational-analysis platform, not a broker or auto-trading service. Members remain responsible for deciding whether and how to act on any signal.

Risk note: Market signals and sizing examples are not financial advice, and trading can result in losses.

Back to top ↑

## 🎤 Voice & Communication

ElevenLabs

Text to speech · Voice generation · Multilingual audio

Generates natural-sounding speech for videos, podcasts, presentations, and AI experiences across multiple languages.

Why it stands out: It delivers production-quality voiceovers without a traditional recording workflow.

Explore ElevenLabs →

CallHippo

Cloud phone · Omnichannel inbox · AI agents

Brings calls, messages, WhatsApp, analytics, and AI-powered agents into one business communication platform.

Why it stands out: It automates routine communication while keeping customer interactions organized.

Explore CallHippo →

Chatbase

Customer support · AI agents · Omnichannel CX

Builds AI customer-support agents trained on your documents, websites, or databases, then deploys them across web chat, email, messaging, and voice.

Why it stands out: Its actions, integrations, analytics, lead capture, and human escalation help agents resolve requests instead of only answering questions.

Explore Chatbase →

Choose by workflow

Create · Support · Communicate

ElevenLabs for generated voice and audio.

Chatbase for trainable, omnichannel customer-support agents.

CallHippo for cloud calling and business communication operations.

Back to top ↑

## 🧭 How tools earn a spot This collection favors tools that: - Solve a real problem in an active workflow - Save meaningful time or unlock a new revenue path - Are approachable without a large technical team - Deliver enough value to recommend from personal experience Tools are intentionally removed when they no longer fit the collection. Features and pricing change, so always check the linked website before making a purchase decision. ## 🤝 Suggest a tool Know a tool that belongs here? [Open an issue](https://github.com/cporter202/awesome-ai-tools/issues/new) and share: - What the tool does - The workflow it improves - Why it is better than the obvious alternatives - Whether you have used it personally ## ☕ Support the project
If this list saves you time, you can help keep it curated and current.
